scenarios.fixture: Deterministic matched segmented 1200x800 and 3600x2400 fixtures (opaque base, transparent selected layer with two separated red squares) built procedurally on both sides plus Rust baseline composites.
steps: Fresh editors/images for selection inverse, 5px expand/contract from a center-half rectangle, zero-tolerance contiguous/noncontiguous wand clicks and layer-alpha silhouette selection.
Alternate applications across launches; warmups and samples are explicit.
assertions: Selection dimensions/bounds, changed interior/exterior coverage probes and undo restoration in each driver; trial-1 paired .selcov channel dumps compared at both sizes (coverage materialized and asserted every sample; only the first measured sample per trial is dumped).

scenarios.limits: CPU workload, not UI latency. GIMP total includes a destructive visible-layer merge; materialized selection coverage is timed and dumped separately. Picsie expand edges are antialiased while GIMP grow edges are hard (quantified edge ring, not parity); GIMP shrink/grow opening is not reversible (contract restoration recreates the input). Suite-locked: running this scenario never executes the performance.features layer/mask workloads.

scenarios.fixture: Deterministic matched group/gradient/adjustment 1200x800 and 3600x2400 fixtures (folder with two raster children; mid-gray layers; gray plus white-square layer) built procedurally on both sides plus Rust baseline composites.
steps: Fresh editors/images for folder group 200% resize and 30-degree rotate, full-width linear black-to-white image and mask gradients, and one live Levels/Curves filter/adjustment update inside the open transaction.
Alternate applications across launches; warmups and samples are explicit.
assertions: Hierarchy/member-geometry, gradient-endpoint, mask-coverage-channel, tone-probe and undo/cancel restoration in each driver; trial-1 paired .rgba dumps compared at both sizes plus the trial-1 .maskcov channel for the mask gradient.

Keep command, materialized-coverage, render and complete-RGBA timings distinct; GIMP group transforms bake resampling (labeled, not equal-quality parity) and masks paint in linear light (quantified mid-band difference, not parity).
scenarios.limits: CPU workload, not UI latency. GIMP total includes a destructive visible-layer merge; Picsie group transforms stay live while GIMP bakes resampling into children (labeled representation difference, never an equal-quality speed claim). Mask-gradient mids differ systematically (GIMP linear-light masks vs Picsie encoded coverage). Levels/Curves use matched perceptual mapping (byte-identical probes in pilots). GIMP rotate has no sound inverse (padding re-bbox); only hierarchy preservation is controlled. Suite-locked: running this scenario never executes the layer/mask or selection workloads.
